note: Pinned developer toolchain for the Console Simulator. Nothing here needs root or administrator rights: zig is a user-space archive, the Debian packages are fetched with apt-get download (signed by the distribution's apt index) and extracted into a user prefix with dpkg-deb -x.

zig.license: MIT (zig), with bundled LLVM/clang (Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception) and musl (MIT)

debian_packages.distribution: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (resolute), the WSL distribution already present on the workstation

libc6-armhf-cross.purpose: armhf glibc runtime (dynamic loader + libc) for the optional dynamic ARM build; verifies that missing ARM runtime libraries fail understandably

host_compilers.linux_x86_64: gcc 15.2.0 (Ubuntu), already installed in the WSL distribution
